Memory Match Game

Flip the cards and match all 8 emoji pairs — with a move counter, timer and win stats.

📖 How to use

  1. Press Start (or just flip your first card).
  2. Click two cards to flip them.
  3. Matching pairs stay face-up; misses flip back.
  4. Match all 8 pairs to see your time and move count.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Are the cards in the same place each game?

No, they're shuffled fresh every game with an unbiased Fisher–Yates shuffle.

How do I play?

Flip any two cards. Match all 8 pairs to win. Mismatched cards flip back after a moment.

Is my time tracked?

Yes — the timer starts on your first flip and stops when you match the last pair.
